editorial:
You follow Brandy Klark, a straight-A high school valedictorian who realizes she has zero romantic experience before heading to college. Instead of panicking, she treats the problem like homework and builds a checklist of everything she wants to try over one wild summer. The vibe is raunchy, awkward, and surprisingly sweet, with Aubrey Plaza perfectly nailing the role of a smart girl who is clueless about love. The supporting cast, including Bill Hader and Rachel Bilson, keeps the laughs coming while the story stays grounded in real teenage confusion. You will cringe, laugh, and maybe even feel a little nostalgic for your own messy coming-of-age moments.

The pacing is quick and the jokes land often, though some scenes push the gross-out humor a bit far. The heart of the film is Brandy learning that checking boxes is not the same as real connection, which gives the comedy some weight. If you enjoy bold, R-rated humor with a soft center, this one delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Brandy finally crosses off the last item on her list but realizes the experience felt empty without genuine feelings. She turns down a casual hookup with her crush and instead shares a real, honest moment with her pool manager, Willy. The twist is that her checklist was never really about sex, it was about growing up. She heads to college wiser, still a little awkward, but finally comfortable in her own skin.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves bold teen comedies with heart.
